messages.subject: Model Statistic = 0 and 0 DF?
parts:
I have been trying to run a simple mediation model:

Homework ~ SAT + Gender
SAT ~ Gender

but I keep getting the result that there are 0 df for the model and the test statistic is zero. I have this issue across multiple data sets and with multiple different models of the same structure. I have Gender as a fixed variable but still have this issue. What is going wrong here?

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Model Statistic = 0 and 0 DF?
parts: Nothing is going wrong. This happens when you have a saturaded model, this means that you are estimating as many parameters as unique elements from your data covariance matrix. When you have a saturated model you are replicating all the elements of the coavriance matrix, so you have df=0, and the model cannot estimate fit indices (more like have perfct prediction of the coavriance matrix)
